description: keyseal format v1 conformance vectors. Open each bundle with the reserved `test` provider returning `dataKey`, the clock set to `now`, and the environment pinned to `env` when present. `ok` vectors must ask the provider for the data key with exactly `keyContext` and yield exactly `secrets` (with a previous value only where listed); the others must fail with `error`.

vectors.name: empty
vectors.description: A bundle with no secrets.

vectors.name: basic
vectors.description: Several secrets, including an empty, a non-ASCII and a multi-line value.

vectors.name: previous-live
vectors.description: A rotated secret whose previous value is inside its grace window.

vectors.name: previous-expired
vectors.description: The same bundle read after the grace window: previous must not be returned.

vectors.name: prototype-names
vectors.description: Names that collide with object internals in some languages.

vectors.name: rekeyed
vectors.description: A rekeyed bundle: epoch 2, which the reader must pass to its key provider.

vectors.name: tampered-value
vectors.description: One ciphertext character changed.

vectors.name: version-changed
vectors.description: Bundle version edited.

vectors.name: secret-removed
vectors.description: A secret deleted from the file.

vectors.name: epoch-changed
vectors.description: Key epoch edited, as if to dodge a revocation of the bundle's real epoch.

vectors.name: previous-removed
vectors.description: A grace-window previous value deleted.

vectors.name: wrong-data-key
vectors.description: An untouched bundle opened with a different data key.

vectors.name: swapped-values-valid-mac
vectors.description: Two values swapped and the MAC recomputed: the AAD must bind each value to its name.

vectors.name: slot-swap-valid-mac
vectors.description: Current and previous ciphertexts swapped and the MAC recomputed.

vectors.name: env-renamed-valid-mac
vectors.description: Environment renamed and the MAC recomputed: the AAD must bind values to the environment.

vectors.name: unknown-field
vectors.description: An extra top-level field.

vectors.name: future-format
vectors.description: A format version this reader doesn't know.

vectors.name: padded-mac
vectors.description: Base64 padding on the MAC.

vectors.name: bad-name
vectors.description: A secret name starting with a digit.

vectors.name: previous-not-older
vectors.description: previous.v equal to v.

vectors.name: fractional-timestamp
vectors.description: Milliseconds in a timestamp.

vectors.name: version-zero
vectors.description: A version below 1.

vectors.name: epoch-missing
vectors.description: A key reference without an epoch.

vectors.name: epoch-zero
vectors.description: A key epoch below 1.

vectors.name: env-pinned-mismatch
vectors.description: A valid bundle, but the reader pins another environment.

vectors.name: other-provider
vectors.description: The bundle names a key provider the reader didn't supply.

localDescription: The `local` provider (section 4.3). Holding only `key`, unwrap `wrapped` for `keyId` with `keyContext`. `ok` vectors must derive `derivedKeyId` from `key` and return `dataKey`; the others must fail with `error`.

local.name: local-unwrap
local.description: A data key wrapped with a local key, at epoch 2.

local.name: local-epoch-changed
local.description: The same wrapped key presented under another epoch.

local.name: local-env-changed
local.description: The same wrapped key presented for another environment.

local.name: local-bundle-changed
local.description: The same wrapped key copied into another bundle.

local.name: local-tampered
local.description: One byte of the wrapped key changed.

local.name: local-truncated
local.description: A wrapped key one byte short.

local.name: local-other-key
local.description: The reader holds a different local key than the bundle names.
